nodes.name: skybox.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements cubemap skybox rendering: loads compiled shaders, builds a unit cube, and draws a camera-locked environment with tint and exposure from render settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Strips view translation so the cube stays camera-centered; uses a front-face cull and read-only depth so the skybox sits behind the scene.

nodes.name: model_util.cpp
nodes.summary: Shared model import helpers: WIC texture loading with an SRV cache, MTL/FBX diffuse texture resolution, and FBX skinned-mesh evaluation via a process-wide FbxManager.
nodes.languageNotes: Caches WIC-decoded SRVs by wide path; FbxShared owns the SDK manager/IO settings for the process lifetime.

nodes.name: particle_system.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the CPU particle pool, emitter simulation (shapes, lifetime color/size, gravity), and GPU billboard instancing with additive or alpha blending.
nodes.languageNotes: ParticleSystem is a singleton; ParticleRenderer_* builds instanced billboard meshes and binds blend states per emitter.

nodes.name: line_sprite.cpp
nodes.summary: Draws a camera-facing world-space quad stretched between two points, used for ropes and trails with depth testing enabled.

nodes.name: line_sprite.h
nodes.summary: Declares LineSprite initialize/finalize/draw for a depth-tested, camera-facing quad between two world points.

nodes.name: LoadCompiledShader
nodes.summary: Reads a compiled shader blob from disk and creates the skybox vertex and pixel shaders.

nodes.name: Skybox_Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates skybox shaders, cube geometry, constant buffers, sampler, and raster/depth states from the D3D11 device.

nodes.name: Skybox_Finalize
nodes.summary: Releases skybox GPU objects and clears the cached cubemap path.

nodes.name: Skybox_ReloadFromSettings
nodes.summary: Loads or clears the skybox cubemap from RenderSettings, converting the path with ToWString.

nodes.name: Skybox_Draw
nodes.summary: Draws the camera-locked cube with current view/projection, tint, and exposure, restoring prior D3D state afterward.

nodes.name: ModelUtil_ReleaseTextureCache
nodes.summary: Releases every cached model texture SRV; must run before the D3D11 device is destroyed.

nodes.name: Trim
nodes.summary: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from a std::string in place.

nodes.name: Split
nodes.summary: Splits a string on a separator character into a vector of tokens.

nodes.name: WideToUTF8
nodes.summary: Converts a wide Windows path to a UTF-8 std::string.

nodes.name: Utf8ToWide
nodes.summary: Converts a UTF-8 C string to a std::wstring.

nodes.name: DirnameW
nodes.summary: Returns the parent directory of a wide path.

nodes.name: JoinPathW
nodes.summary: Joins a wide directory and file name, inserting a separator when needed.

nodes.name: IsAbsolutePathW
nodes.summary: Reports whether a wide path is absolute (drive or UNC).

nodes.name: LoadTextureWIC_Internal
nodes.summary: Decodes an image with WIC, creates a mipmapped D3D11 SRV, and inserts it into the path cache.

nodes.name: LoadTextureWIC_SRV
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that loads or returns a cached WIC texture SRV.

nodes.name: TryLoadMTLTexture_SRV
nodes.summary: Parses an MTL file for map_Kd and loads the diffuse texture plus UV scale/offset/clamp flags.

nodes.name: FindFirstDiffuseFileTexture
nodes.summary: Walks an FBX node material graph to find the first diffuse file texture and its UV set.

nodes.name: TransformNormal_IT
nodes.summary: Transforms a normal by an inverse-transpose FBX matrix.

nodes.name: HasNegativeDeterminant
nodes.summary: Returns whether an FBX matrix has a negative determinant (winding flip).

nodes.name: FbxShared
nodes.summary: Constructs the process-wide FBX manager and IO settings.

nodes.name: ~FbxShared
nodes.summary: Destroys the shared FBX manager on process teardown.

nodes.name: EnumerateSkinnedMeshes
nodes.summary: Recursively collects FBX meshes that have skin deformers.

nodes.name: ComputeSkinnedCP_ForMesh
nodes.summary: Evaluates an FBX skin at a time and writes deformed control-point positions and normals.

nodes.name: LoadCompiledShader
nodes.summary: Loads a compiled particle shader blob from disk for the billboard renderer.

nodes.name: CreateBlendState
nodes.summary: Creates additive or alpha D3D11 blend states used by particle billboards.

nodes.name: Reset
nodes.summary: Clears a ParticlePool or the ParticleSystem emitter list so simulation can restart.

nodes.name: Spawn
nodes.summary: Allocates a live particle in the pool with position, velocity, size, color, and lifetime.

nodes.name: Tick
nodes.summary: Advances particle or emitter simulation: aging, gravity, emission, and compacting dead particles.

nodes.name: Compact
nodes.summary: Packs live particles to the front of the pool after deaths.

nodes.name: CopyParticle
nodes.summary: Copies all per-particle attributes from one pool slot to another.

nodes.name: ParticleEmitter
nodes.summary: Constructs an emitter, assigns its id, and applies the initial ParticleEmitterConfig.

nodes.name: SetConfig
nodes.summary: Applies emitter configuration and resizes/resets the underlying particle pool.

nodes.name: Render
nodes.summary: Forwards alive emitters to the GPU billboard renderer.

nodes.name: Stop
nodes.summary: Stops emission and optionally marks the emitter to destroy when empty.

nodes.name: Emit
nodes.summary: Spawns particles from the emitter shape using random position, direction, and lifetime ranges.

nodes.name: RandomShapePosition
nodes.summary: Samples a spawn position inside the configured sphere, cone, box, or edge shape.

nodes.name: RandomDirection
nodes.summary: Samples an emission direction for the current shape, falling back to up if degenerate.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Initializes the ParticleSystem singleton by creating the GPU billboard renderer.

nodes.name: Finalize
nodes.summary: Resets emitters and releases particle renderer GPU resources.

nodes.name: CreateEmitter
nodes.summary: Allocates a new ParticleEmitter and returns its id.

nodes.name: SetEmitterPosition
nodes.summary: Moves a live emitter to a world position.

nodes.name: SetEmitterEmitting
nodes.summary: Toggles whether a named emitter is currently emitting.

nodes.name: StopEmitter
nodes.summary: Stops a named emitter, optionally destroying it when empty.

nodes.name: DestroyEmitter
nodes.summary: Removes an emitter from the system immediately.

nodes.name: SetEmitterConfig
nodes.summary: Replaces the configuration of an existing emitter.

nodes.name: SpawnParticle
nodes.summary: Manually injects one particle into a named emitter pool.

nodes.name: ParticleRenderer_Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates particle billboard shaders, input layout, instance buffers, and blend states.

nodes.name: ParticleRenderer_Finalize
nodes.summary: Releases particle renderer shaders, buffers, and blend states.

nodes.name: ParticleRenderer_RenderEmitter
nodes.summary: Uploads instance data for an emitter and draws camera-facing billboards with the emitter texture.

nodes.name: LineSprite_Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates the line-sprite vertex/index buffers and a no-cull rasterizer state.

nodes.name: LineSprite_Finalize
nodes.summary: Releases line-sprite GPU buffers and rasterizer state.

nodes.name: LineSprite_Draw
nodes.summary: Builds a camera-facing quad between two world points and draws it with the white texture and tint.
